profile.summary: Tides Center is a nonprofit organization, tax-exempt under Section 501(c)(3), that acts as a fiscal sponsor for social change projects. It provides finance, legal and human resources support, including payroll, benefits and grants management, so project leaders can run their work without forming their own organization.
